scope: Home/office examples; specialist prerequisites documented per user clarification. Implemented does not mean hardware-validated.

configuration.rst.scope: Single-port, bridge, gateway; native or protocol-none recipe; current FDB and admin-state semantics. Specialist CPU affinity/bonding excluded by agreed scope.

b53.rst.scope: Native recipes shared with all taggers; protocol-none conduit VLAN recipes remove default VID membership on other PVIDs. No model-name condition.

dsa.rst.scope: Read active tag protocol. Runtime tag changes/cascades are specialist configurations with prerequisites documented.

lan9303.rst.scope: Standalone isolation and bridge forwarding/leave-rejoin behavior. Exact current harness requires four cables; no claim of validation on two-port hardware.

bcm_sf2.rst.scope: Ordinary tagged DSA recipes; MoCA/WoL/platform specialist requirements documented.

sja1105.rst.scope: Common standalone/bridge/VLAN semantics; timed gates, TSN and composed trap/redirect examples excluded by agreed scope.
